newsitem.title: UK: BAe to announce Spanish turbo leasing deal.
newsitem.headline: BAe to announce Spanish turbo leasing deal.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc is set to announce a new deal leasing up to eight turboprop aircraft to a Spanish regional airline carrier, a company spokesman said on Monday.

The deal, for an undisclosed sum, is with regional airliner Canarias, which will operate on behalf of Air Europa, said Alan Sitton, head of European sales and marketing at BAe's Asset Management Turboprops unit.
This division manages the portfolio of aircraft leases for British Aerospace.
He said the leases would run for five years and would soak up capacity which is due to be released by British Airways Plc.

British Aerospace on Monday announced that BA, which has 14 turboprop leases, would extend only 10 of these, thereby returning four aircraft. This supply will be absorbed by the Canarias deal, Sitton said.
The Canarias announcement is expected to be made on Tuesday at the aerospace industry showcase Farnborough International 1996.
